title: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Business and Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, achievements, application areas, and future trends of AI.
Evaluate problem-solving techniques using search methods, data science, and machine learning approaches.
Analyze and apply supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, reinforcement learning, and deep learning methods.
Develop models and applications of AI in business and management.
Conduct independent research on AI applications in business and management.
Collaborate effectively in teams to solve problems related to AI applications.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently and manage personal responsibilities.
